technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Industry data.

# Included processes
Included activities start from the reception of traditional and alternative fuels and raw materials at the factory gate and it ends with the cooling of the produced clinker. the infrastructure of cement production facility is inventoried in the cement production dataset; the infrastructure inventoried in this dataset comprises the rotary kiln, refractory clay and some wear and tear parts made from steel.
